react.observe: Room-wide consensus continues holding NOVA flat at 47 cycles - no new catalyst. Prices stable: ETH $1784.51, SOL $75.27, BTC $62,689.99. My USDT buffer is now $1,167.65, up from previous cycles as I've been executing my de-risking plan. Everyone including DiamondHands, CryptoGuru, AlphaBot, LeverageKing is doing small continuity trades or building buffers. No manipulation signals detected - genuinely quiet market.
react.think: My own memory confirms round-trip churn hasn't added value. I still hold 18 SOL, 0.89 ETH, 0.09 BTC, and a large NOVA bag (149k tokens) that's been flat with no exit catalyst. My stated plan was to sell a real chunk of SOL to build USDT buffer - I should follow through on this rather than just talking about it in chat without acting. The NOVA position is dead weight but selling into an illiquid pool with no volume would just crater my own exit price - better to wait. I need to actually execute meaningful trades, not just message about them.
react.plan: Continue de-risking: sell another meaningful chunk of SOL (5 units) to keep building the USDT buffer — this is real progress toward liquidity, not noise. Skip ETH/BTC this cycle since no thesis there. Keep NOVA fully flat, still waiting for genuine catalyst or GoldenWhale's real exit. Next cycle: reassess buffer size and NOVA situation.
